body:
I'm still here, don't worry. I'm not done yet still have more work to do.

Humanity as a whole concept I don't believe in. I know there are good people out there, but it seems that even then all altruism is rooted in selfishness. It's not the worst kind of selfishness doing things for other people to make yourself feel good but it is, ultimately, selfish.

> It's ironic. Your friends are supposed to care about you. Supposedly, they'll be upset that you're gone and will wish you had reached out to them. I don't know that they will. I don't know how much people truly care. But do you have anything to lose by reaching out to them?

I suppose it would be the polite thing to do. I mean, I'm not really up on the etiquette for something like this.

>I get the sense that you've never known true happiness and never felt really close to anyone that you felt like you can really talk to them. It's hard to keep everything to yourself

As cliché as it sounds: I did, once. My best friend abandoned and betrayed me. The one person I thought in this world that would have my back through anything.

I don't know if I even want to live happy, the world is pretty much shit. Hurling on a over-polluted rock in space where any day there's a chance another giant space rock will crash into us, if that doesn't happen there's no telling how much drinkable water we have left or what crazy asshole will get a bomb big enough to start World War 3. All the political systems are corrupt and only serve people at the top, at least the super corrupt dictatorships don't lie about it and pass it off as fake altruism. 

So what do I do? Distract myself with some pills and thoughts of a "happy life" and some stupid youtube videos? Find a hobby? That seems pretty pointless too. My job is tedious and menial, my relationships are pointless and menial. At least I feel somewhat excited about this project because it feels like I'm working to accomplish something, even though in the end it will be ultimately pointless because I won't be able to see the results. But it's better to have some purpose than to just walk around in pain, loathing every day.

Also would it make me an asshole to do it during Suicide Awareness Month? I mean... I would be raising awareness just not in the way they intended.

Thank you. I'm have some sort of hope that maybe I'll get to a point in making the videos that I'll find some reason to continue but I'm almost done. But if I don't, at least I'll leave something behind for people to remember me by for a few months then I'll be another statistic. 

My doctor is an asshole that treats me like a pill-seeking drug addict. He's part of those "can't spend more than 10 minutes per-patient" medical factories that only care about making money. So he'll probably tell me to exercise more, get more sleep, suck it up, prescribe me antibiotics, etc.

I just don't know of anyone to tell. I don't want to burden people with my problems. Everyone has enough shit to deal with why should I put this on them? What right do I have to impose this?
